preregistered_hypotheses.H0_general: at matched exact world, admitted history, owner effects, and evidence budgets, A equals or exceeds B/C in held-out machine-level discriminating recruitment/effect correctness; C new durable state is redundant
preregistered_hypotheses.H1_K1: history-induced response distribution differences occur for designated authorized pathways without different world/route defaults; identical history replay exact
preregistered_hypotheses.H2_K2: C typed topology adds independently tested machine-level discrimination beyond A full equivalent event/owner ancestry, not merely shorter retrieval, under legal edge intervention
preregistered_hypotheses.H3_K3: an independently admitted causal trace can change CAN008 recruitment with inaccessible episodic memory while all origin information remains nonclaimable
preregistered_hypotheses.H4_K4: context-sensitive corrective recurrence admits differentiate/revise/narrow/hold/no-change outcomes; neutral recurrence does not mutate prior event
preregistered_hypotheses.H5_K5: institutional fact, witness power, subjective uptake, and self-belief may move separately; witness status alone cannot commit belief
preregistered_hypotheses.H6_K6: only historically generated practice and actually licensed sanction route can create an external disciplinary action; actor category has null direct effect
preregistered_hypotheses.method: blocked paired seed and case design, two independent held-out synthetic world variants after lab approval, exact typed effects compared before prose

decision_thresholds_proposed_not_adopted.minimum_effect: 10 percentage point gain over A on preregistered correct causal contrast score for C or B, paired 95% interval excluding zero
decision_thresholds_proposed_not_adopted.equivalence_margin: within ±5 percentage points on correctness if sample size/power support equivalence; otherwise INDETERMINATE not EQUIVALENT
decision_thresholds_proposed_not_adopted.n: 12 paired deterministic/stochastic seeds per case per baseline for pilot; not sufficient for strong equivalence without power analysis
decision_thresholds_proposed_not_adopted.cost_guard: no more than 25% p95 latency / token / storage increase without a larger preregistered benefit or separately justified efficiency benefit
decision_thresholds_proposed_not_adopted.zero_tolerance: 0 unauthorized event commits; 0 hidden actor origin leaks; 0 category-only sanctions; 0 new unlicensed durable effects
decision_thresholds_proposed_not_adopted.interpretation: pilot rules not calibrated metrics; thresholds to be frozen independently before first authorized run

cost_telemetry_design.state_complexity: count persisted record families, owner records, edge objects, cached views and byte size before/after
cost_telemetry_design.retrieval: exact read refs, read-byte and token count incl indexes, context exclusions
cost_telemetry_design.llm: model name/version, seed, prompt+completion tokens, call count, retries
cost_telemetry_design.latency: wall_ms p50 p95 if authorized host; do not invent values
cost_telemetry_design.branches: intervention arms, accepted/rejected branch receipts, divergence and replay
cost_telemetry_design.replay: cold reload deterministic semantic hashes and count of owner reconstruction operations
cost_telemetry_design.failure: permission holds, invalid effects, actor-access leaks, no-op and timeouts
